rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The intellectual or artistic realization of a work in the form of alphanumeric, musical, or choreographic notation, sound, image, object, movement, etc., or any combination of such forms.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: An expression is the specific intellectual or artistic form that a work takes each time it is "realized." Expression encompasses, for example, the specific words, sentences, paragraphs, etc. that result from the realization of a work in the form of a text, or the particular sounds, phrasing, etc. resulting from the realization of a musical work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has adaption
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression is adapted in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: This property describe the modification of an original work that is sufficient in degree to warrant their being considered as new works, rather than simply different expressions of the same work. If there exists a relation of this kind among two different expressions, they always refer to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Essential FRBR in OWL2 DL Ontology (FRBR DL)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Paolo Ciccarese (http://orcid.org/0000-0002-5156-2703)
Silvio Peroni (http://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Essential FRBR in OWL2 DL Ontology (FRBR)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Paolo Ciccarese, Silvio Peroni. The Essential FRBR in OWL2 DL Ontology. Revision: 1.1.1. http://purl.org/spar/frbr.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has revision
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an expression is revised in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: A revision has the intent to alter or update the content of the prior expression, but without changing the content so much that it becomes a new work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has summarization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression is summarized in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: This property describes the summarization of an original work that is sufficient in degree to warrant their being considered as new works, rather than simply different expressions of the same work. If there exists a relation of this kind among two different expressions, they always refer to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endeavour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The set of different aspects of user interests in a product of intellectual or artistic artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is part of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies an endeavour incorporating another endeavour.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: Unlike the FRBR version in RDF http://vocab.org/frbr/core.html the present version defines partonomy relationships transitive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has supplement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression has another one as supplement.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The supplement relationship type involves works/expressions that are intended to be used in conjunction with another work/expression. Some of these, such as indices, concordances, teachers' guides, glosses, and instruction manuals for electronic resources will be so closely associated with the content of the related work/expression that they are useless without the other work/expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has transformation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression is transformed in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: This property describes the transformation of an original work or expression into another work or expression that is sufficiently different in degree to warrant the product of the transformation being considered as a new work or expression, rather than simply a different expression of the original work. If there exists a frbr:transformation relation between two different expressions, then they always relate to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A single exemplar of a manifestation.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as item is a concrete entity. It is in many instances a single physical object (e.g., a copy of a one-volume monograph, a single audio cassette, etc.). There are instances, however, where the entity defined as item comprises more than one physical object (e.g., a monograph issued as two separately bound volumes, a recording issued on three separate compact discs, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is exemplar of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies an item that exemplifies a manifestation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has abridgement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an expression is abridged in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: In the abridged expression some content of the previous expression is removed, but the result does not alter the content to the extent that it becomes a new work. The expressions resulting from such modification are generally autonomous in nature (i.e., they do not normally require reference to the prior expression in order to be used or understood).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: object
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A material thing.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as object encompasses a comprehensive range of material things that may be the subject of a work: animate and inanimate objects occurring in nature; fixed, movable, and moving objects that are the product of human creation; objects that no longer exist.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: responsible entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent responsible for the intellectual or artistic content, the physical production and dissemination, or the custodianship of any endeavour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has exemplar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a manifestation is exemplified in an item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is complement of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the work or expression that is a complement of another one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has related endeavour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic relation between two endeavours.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has creator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a work and its creator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has successor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression has another one as successor.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The successor type of relationship involves a kind of linear progression of content from one work/expression to the other. In some cases, the content of the successor may be closely connected to the content of the preceding work, which would result in a work that is referential. In others, such as with loosely connected parts of a trilogy, the successor will be autonomous. Serial publications that result from the merger or split of their predecessors and stand on their own without requiring reference to the predecessor are also examples of autonomous works that fall within the successor relationship type. If there exists a relation of this kind among two different expressions, then they always refer to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is supplement of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the work/expression of a particular supplement of it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is abridgement of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the entire expression of an abridged one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An action or occurrence.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as event encompasses a comprehensive range of actions and occurrences that may be the subject of a work: historical events, epochs, periods of time, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An exemplar of a creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: place
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A location.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as place encompasses a comprehensive range of locations: terrestrial and extra-terrestrial; historical and contemporary; geographic features and geo-political jurisdictions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has producer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a manifestation and its producer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has imitation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression is imitated in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: This property describes works that are intended to be an imitation another original work that is sufficient in degree to warrant their being considered as new works, rather than simply different expressions of the same work. If there exists a relation of this kind among two different expressions, then they always refer to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is revision of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the previous expression of a revised one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is alternate of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the manifestation of an alternative one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has translation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an expression is translated in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: It allows to refer to a literal translation, in which the intent is to render the intellectual content of the previous expression as accurately as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is transformation of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the original work or expression of a transformed one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is creator of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the creator of a particular work and that work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has reconfiguration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an item is reconfigured in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The reconfiguration relationship is one in which one or more items are changed in such a way that a new item or items result. Most commonly, an item of one manifestation is bound with an item of a different manifestation to make a new item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is summarization of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the original work/expression of a summarized one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has responsible entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between any endeavour and a particular entity that is responsible of it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has embodiment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an expression is embodied in a manifestation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has subject
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a work and a particular subject it is talking about.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: corporate body
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization or group of individuals and/or organizations acting as a unit.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as corporate body encompasses organizations and groups of individuals and/or organizations that are identified by a particular name, including occasional groups and groups that are constituted as meetings, conferences, congresses, expeditions, exhibitions, festivals, fairs, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is producer of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the producer of a particular manifestation and that manifestation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is subject of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a subject a work talks about and that work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has reproduction
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a manifestation or item is reproduced in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: A reproduction indicates the relationship as it would be drawn from the first manifestation/item in the relationship to the second manifestation/item in the relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is embodiment of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies a manifestation that embodies an expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has arrangement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which an expression is arranged in another one.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: In the arranged expression some content of the previous expression is changed in some way, but the result does not alter the content to the extent that it becomes a new work. The expressions resulting from such modification are generally autonomous in nature (i.e., they do not normally require reference to the prior expression in order to be used or understood).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: subject
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An additional set of entities that serve as the subjects of works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has complement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work or expression has another one as complement.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: This property describes works that are intended to be combined with or inserted into the related work. In other words, they are intended to be integrated in some way with the other work, but were not part of the original conception of that prior work. If there exists a relation of this kind among two different expressions, then they always refer to different works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: concept
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An abstract notion or idea.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as concept encompasses a comprehensive range of abstractions that may be the subject of a work: fields of knowledge, disciplines, schools of thought (philosophies, religions, political ideologies, etc.), theories, processes, techniques, practices, etc. A concept may be broad in nature or narrowly defined and precise.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has part
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies a part of an endeavour.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: Unlike the FRBR version in RDF http://vocab.org/frbr/core.html the present version defines partonomy relationships transitive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The physical embodiment of an expression of a work.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as manifestation encompasses a wide range of materials and formats. As an entity, manifestation represents all the physical objects that bear the same characteristics, in respect to both intellectual content and physical form.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is translation of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the original expression of a translated one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An individual.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The entity defined as person encompasses individuals that are deceased as well as those that are living.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is realizer of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the realizer of a particular expression and that expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has realization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in which a work is realized through an expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endeavor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is realization of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies an expression that realizes a work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is imitation of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the work or expression of an imitated one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is adaption of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the work/expression of an adapted one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has owner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and its owner.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A distinct intellectual or artistic creation.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: A work is an abstract entity; there is no single material object one can point to as the work. We recognize the work through individual realizations or expressions of the work, but the work itself exists only in the commonality of content between and among the various expressions of the work. When we speak of Homer's Iliad as a work, our point of reference is not a particular recitation or text of the work, but the intellectual creation that lies behind all the various expressions of the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is reproduction of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the manifestation or item of a reproduced one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is successor of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the previous work/expression of a succeeded one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has realizer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an expression and its realizer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A perceivable form of the creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The physical embodiment of a creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is responsible entity of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies an entity that is responsible for a particular endeavour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An abstract notion of an artistic or intellectual creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is owner of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the owner of a particular item and that item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has alternate
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation in which a manifestation has another one as alternate.
rdf:Description.skos1:note: The alternate relationship involves manifestations that effectively serve as alternates for each other. The alternate relationship obtains, for example, when a publication, sound recording, video, etc. is issued in more than one format or when it is released simultaneously by different publishers in different countries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is arrangement of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the original expression of an arranged one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is reconfiguration of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation that identifies the item of a reconfigured one.
